==Dialogue ==
{{Quest Description|As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to the Midnight Ranger on guard)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_86_1.ogg}} '''Midnight Ranger on Guard:''' General, we're all clear in the west!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_86_2.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Good. Have you had more hallucinations after the antidote?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_86_3.ogg}} '''Midnight Ranger on Guard:''' No sign of those Retroact Rain Phantoms they warned us about, but...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_86_4.ogg}} '''Midnight Ranger on Guard:''' I just heard some weird noises from the north.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_86_5.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Stay here and hold your post. I'll go check it out.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_86_6.ogg}} '''Midnight Ranger on Guard:''' Understood!
----
;(Talk to the Steadfast Midnight Ranger)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_1_2.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' General.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_2.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Greetings. How are you feeling after the antidote?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_3.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' I feel much better, but the Phantoms are still coming back from time to time. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_4.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' Three years... It's been three years already.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_5.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' I was on the vanguard team during that battle. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_6.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' Memories of my teammates lost their minds fighting those Phantoms haunts me to this day...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_7.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' Those Phantoms... Illusions of both soldiers and those monsters... They were not real, but somehow they could injure and kill us.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_8.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' We had to strike them down to survive.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_9.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' But then... Our dead comrades, were coming back to life, ready to stab us behind our backs... It was chaos. We were terrified, couldn't tell friend from foe...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_10.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' The Retroact Rain contains Remnant energy that can recreate past events and project them as Phantoms. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_11.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Those Phantoms can transform into familiar people or objects by resonating with living people in the rain, through their frequencies.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_12.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' During that battle, the rain's effect was further enhanced by the Threnodian's power.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_13.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' That was why the Phantoms gained physical forms, and why the rain could recreate very recent events, like bringing back soldiers dead minutes ago.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_14.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Unaware of the mechanism behind it, we tried to eliminate all the Phantoms, and it only worsened the situation.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_15.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Now we know the Phantoms are merely replicas of past events.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_16.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' While not a perfect solution, the antidote for Retroact Rain can lessen its effects and help us differentiate between reality and hallucinations.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_17.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Keep your chin high. Our fallen comrades wouldn't want to see us down trodden like this.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_18.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' Yes, sir. I will pull myself together!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_89_19.ogg}} '''Steadfast Midnight Ranger:''' General... You were there during the Battle Beneath the Crescent, too. Please be careful of the Phantoms in our camp.
----
;(Watch the two "people" on the right near the computer)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_2_1.ogg}} '''Paranoid Midnight Ranger:''' Can we really trust that medic?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_2_2.ogg}} '''Thoughtful Midnight Ranger:''' I do think we should be careful... Something's wrong with this rain.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_2_3.ogg}} '''Paranoid Midnight Ranger:''' Hey! You see? The raindrops... they're falling up! It's the Retroact Rain!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_2_4.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' That day... As the rain fell, we watched in uncertainty, unsure whether it was a sign of hope or disaster. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_2_5.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' The Retroact Rain should have been a harmless Waveworn Phenomenon. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_2_8.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' However... The Threnodian's influence enhanced its effect, turning that battle into a brutal slaughter.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_2_9.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Our city cannot endure another tragedy like that...
----
;(Watch the two "people" on the left near the canopy)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_4_1.ogg}} '''Veteran Midnight Ranger:''' Let's join the Riverside Games after we beat that monster.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_4_2.ogg}} '''Young Midnight Ranger:''' The Riverside Games...?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_4_3.ogg}} '''Veteran Midnight Ranger:''' You won first place in the last armed race, remember? Don't back out now... I already counted you in!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_4_4.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' We haven't held the Riverside Games in years. This should be another illusion from the past.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_4_5.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' If everything goes well, perhaps we can hold it again this year...
----
;(Watch the two "people" on the left near the computer)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_5_1.ogg}} '''Excited Midnight Ranger:''' This guy packs a serious punch. It's already so powerful in my hands when I'm just an ordinary person. Now, if I was a Resonator...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_5_7.ogg}} '''Vigilant Midnight Ranger:''' Careful. Tacetite weapons are not so safe to operate.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_5_8.ogg}} '''Excited Midnight Ranger:''' Rest assured. I'll take out those monsters before it blows up in my face!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_5_2.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' The Ministry of Development once designed a weapon for non-Resonator units to combat Tacet Discords.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_5_3.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' As non-Resonators lacked the necessary {{Rubi|Forte|special power}} to control the weapon, and prolonged exposure to Tacetite energy posed health risks, designers limited its output for safety reasons.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_5_4.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' That's why the weapons couldn't operate at full power.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_5_5.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' After taking over as General, I revamped the Midnight Ranger's recruitment tactics. Our primary combat units now consist of Resonators, with a significant decreased in non-Resonator members who have been reassigned to support roles.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_5_6.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' I still remember the admirable courage in those ordinary people's eyes, as they volunteered to join the military... but I cannot let more unnecessary causalities happen.
----
;(Watch the three "people" near the hologram diagram)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_6_1.ogg}} '''Solemn Midnight Rover:''' The plan is simple. We will use the cliffs as a boundary to divide the battlefield into two.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_6_2.ogg}} '''Solemn Midnight Rover:''' Our ranged units will secure the high ground while our ground forces charge through the narrow valley.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_6_3.ogg}} '''Solemn Midnight Rover:''' Meanwhile, we will deploy Resonators to the Suspended Ruins, where most of the Tacet Discords are located.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_6_5.ogg}} '''Solemn Midnight Rover:''' Squads two and three will flank while General Geshu leads Squad one to break their front line.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_6_4.ogg}} '''Solemn Midnight Rover:''' Our goal is to shift from defense to offense and disrupt their strategies. Everything is at stake here.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_6_6.ogg}} '''Solemn Midnight Rover:''' In a word, it's victory or death.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_6_7.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Our strategic plan was crafted 3 years ago, taking into account the terrain in Norfall Barrens. Its value remains crucial today.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_6_8.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' But now, our enemies are even stronger than before.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_6_9.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' There could be unknown risk factors... We must devise a new plan for the current situation.
----
;(Watch the saber on the table on the far left)
:'''Giant Saber with Strange Shape:''' A massive greatsword with a heavy weight. Its texture reveals its power, clearly not meant for the average person.
:'''Giant Saber with Strange Shape:''' Black chains wrap around the blade and hilt, with swirling patterns resembling rippling waves. Dark flames seems to pulse with life, ready to erupt at any moment.
:'''Giant Saber with Strange Shape:''' Droplets of water can be seen on it. Are these the tears of this mighty weapon?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_7_7.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Why am I seeing this here... Is it another illusion caused by the Retroact Rain?
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_1.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' General!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_2.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' We've got all equipment repaired, Tacetite weapons adjusted and given to Resonators. Non-Resonators are also equipped and prepared for action.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_3.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' But... the rain's getting heavier. Should we take shelter for the time being?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_4.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' One of our combat medics claims it's no ordinary downpour, and he strongly advises holding off any moves until it clears.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_5.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' Though young, his sharp intuition has been proven in previous battles. You've seen it firsthand.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_6.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' However... I do agree this will be our last chance at organizing another attack. 
:{{DIcon}} ...The medic you mentioned. What is his name?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_8.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' Sir, his name is...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_9.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' Ji...yan...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_10.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' General, help... Please... help me...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_11.ogg}} '''???:''' What do you make of this, Jiyan?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_12.ogg}} '''???:''' Maybe you are right.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_13.ogg}} '''???:''' The rain just happened out of nowhere. It's indeed unusual. But...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_14.ogg}} '''???:''' This is our only chance.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_15.ogg}} '''???:''' The enemy we've been yearning to destroy is finally right before us.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_16.ogg}} '''???:''' And now you're asking me to sit back and do nothing because of some Phantoms?
:{{DIcon}} (Stay silent.)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_18.ogg}} '''???:''' Silence... is this your response? Or is it fear holding your tongue?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_19.ogg}} '''???:''' Ah... I see. You're no different. We fear, we bleed, we suffer, and in the end, we'll all die on the battlefield. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_20.ogg}} '''???:''' But what about your brethren, friends, and comrades? As you witness them viciously slain before your eyes, one by one...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_21.ogg}} '''???:''' Will you still remain silent when their souls demand an answer?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_22.ogg}} '''???:''' There is no other choice. We must trample the pile of corpses at our feet and push on. Keep barking orders, keep fighting until every last one of those monsters is gone.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_23.ogg}} '''???:''' The Retroact Rain merely creates illusions of past events. My soldiers will not succumb to those hallucinations. I will not allow it.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_26.ogg}} '''???:''' We'll crush anything in our path, no questions asked.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_30.ogg}} '''???:''' And I will pave the way for us all with my Forte.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_27.ogg}} '''???:''' If tens, hundreds, thousands more of my men will die... So be it. We will win this battle, by any means necessary.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_28.ogg}} '''???:''' Jiyan, I have a question for you... What would you have done on that day, if you were in my postion?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_8_29.ogg}} '''???:''' Whatever you say... I'll never answer those brave souls with such silence and cowardice. 
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_112_1.ogg}} '''???:''' Prove yourself to me, Jiyan.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_113_1.ogg}} '''???:''' Caught you off guard, didn't they? Just like what happened on that rainy night...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_114_1.ogg}} '''???:''' Yes... Go on, Keep fighting.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_115_1.ogg}} '''???:''' Fight... Until the last of them is wiped out.
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_1.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' General Geshu Lin... We fight to protect what we cherish.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_2.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' And we cherish our comrades, not out of cowardice of fear, but out of trust. The trust in their lives' worth.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_3.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' I cannot assure you I am always making the right choice, General. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_4.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' But we should never build our victory on top of endless sacrifices... 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_5.ogg}} '''Geshu Lin:''' Hah, is that so?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_6.ogg}} '''Geshu Lin:''' As I see it, we are cut from the same cloth, you and I.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_7.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Perhaps we are indeed, General. I share at least one thing with you. I, too, will draw my blade to fight for what I believe in... and I'll stop at nothing to see it through.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_8.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' General!
:'''Jiyan:''' ...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_10.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' General... You look pale.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_11.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' I am fine. Please go on.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_12.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' We just detected an intense frequency from that Tacet Field ahead.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_13.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' That moon... It's gradually turning full now, as you predicted.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_14.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' The sky... It looks just like how it was during the Battle Beneath the Crescent...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_15.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' It's time.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_16.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' Sir, the Midnight Rangers are ready. We await your orders.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_17.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Attention all troops! Take position and get ready to engage!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_18.ogg}} '''Soldier:''' Yes, sir!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_19.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' "When the moon turns full, a roving traveler shall return"... The prophecy is being fulfilled. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_20.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' Here they are.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_21.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' They're not coming at us... Are they trying to protect something... Or are they waiting for commands?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_10_22.ogg}} '''Jiyan:''' With an TD Outbreak of this magnitude and organization, someone must be orchestrating it. Could it be...
----
;(Cutscene plays)
;(Cutscene ends)
----
:{{DIcon}} Is it just me?
:{{DIcon}} The moon, it's changing...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_12_3.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It looks almost full now.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_12_4.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' And the Retroact Rain falling... Rover, maybe this is "the right time" Madam Magistrate was talking about?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_12_5.ogg}} '''Jinhsi (Contacting):''' ...Citizens of Jinzhou, please remain calm and evacuate in an orderly manner as we practiced during previous drills...
:{{DIcon}} Jinhsi?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_12_7.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' It's a pre-recorded broadcast message. Our Magistrate saw this coming, and she had General Jiyan devise an emergency plan a long time ago.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_12_8.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' This wave of TD attacks should be over now.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_12_9.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' We knew this was coming and we were ready, but oh boy, the amount of TDs is insane. 
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_12_10.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Thanks for coming in time, Rover. It would've taken us much longer to handle this.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_12_11.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Oh, Director Taoqi is here too. For a better run down of the situation, you can find her near the city gate!
----
;(If player talks to Yangyang before Taoqi)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_97_1.ogg}} '''Weary Patroller:''' I must send these supplies to our men...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_97_2.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' You're injured... Please go get yourself patched up first!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_97_3.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Chixia is right. Please leave it to us. We'll help deliver these supplies.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_97_4.ogg}} '''Weary Patroller:''' Huff... Okay... Thank you!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_97_5.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Rover, Yangyang and I need to get these stuff delivered.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_97_6.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Director Taoqi should be at the northern pass. We'll go meet you there as soon as we're done!
----
;(If player talks to Little Boy before Taoqi)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_18_2.ogg}} '''Little Boy:''' Come on! Take down those bad guys!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_18_3.ogg}} '''Worried Patroller:''' It's too dangerous here. Please go back.
----
;(If player talks to Eldery Person before Taoqi)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_17_1.ogg}} '''Elder:''' Young man, we've gathered something for the troops. Please take care.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_17_2.ogg}} '''Caring Patroller:''' Thanks, sir! I'll share them with my teammates. It's dangerous, please head back as soon as possible.
----
;(If player talks to Lingyang before Taoqi)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_14_1.ogg}} '''Little Boy:''' *sob* I-I'm scared...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_14_2.ogg}} '''Lingyang:''' Shhh, everyone will be alright. Look, the Patrollers and guards are all here to help. Those bad monsters won't stand a chance!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_14_3.ogg}} '''Lingyang:''' But it's getting dangerous outside. We'll get you home real quick, okay?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_14_4.ogg}} '''Lingyang:''' Hi, Rover! I'm Lingyang from the Liondance Troupe. Thank you so much for your help! If you don't mind, here's some food. Please have some!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_14_5.ogg}} '''Lingyang:''' Ugh, those damn Tacet Discords. They just keep showing up out of nowhere...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_14_6.ogg}} '''Lingyang:''' But worry not, the Liondance Troupe is here! We'll teach them a lesson!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_14_7.ogg}} '''Lingyang:''' No one can beat us when it comes to morale!
----
;(If player talks to Verina before Taoqi)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_15_1.ogg}} '''Verina:''' This lesion looks bad... Please stay still. I'll heal you with my Forte.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_15_2.ogg}} '''Injured Midnight Ranger:''' My wounds are closing up... Thank you, Miss Verina!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_15_3.ogg}} '''Verina:''' It's nothing. Glad I could help!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_15_4.ogg}} '''Verina:''' Rover, are you alright? Let me heal you if you got injured.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_15_5.ogg}} '''Verina:''' Jinzhou is such a beautiful place. The plants here are incredibly resilient. It's heartbreaking to imagine all of them getting wiped out from this war...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_15_6.ogg}} '''Verina:''' I still have some herbs with me, Rover. They can help your wounds heal. I hope it helps.
----
;(If player talks to Yuanwu before Taoqi)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_13_1.ogg}} '''Sincere Patroller:''' ...And that's all we've gathered so far...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_13_2.ogg}} '''Yuanwu:''' If the wounded can't be transferred to hospitals in time, take them to my teahouse and boxing gym. We can set up temporary medical points there.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_13_3.ogg}} '''Sincere Patroller:''' Thank you, Mr. Yuanwu!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_13_4.ogg}} '''Yuanwu:''' As a citizen, it is my obligation to aid in the face of this immense danger. I'll do my best to assist.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_13_5_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_13_5_F.ogg}} '''Yuanwu:''' Are you alright, younger mister/miss?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_13_6.ogg}} '''Yuanwu:''' This is one of the largest TD Outbreaks I've witnessed. There have already been quite a few casualties. It seems far from over yet.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_13_7.ogg}} '''Yuanwu:''' I still have some supplies with me. Please, take them. Stay safe out there.
----
;(If player talks to Serious Patroller before Taoqi)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_118_1.ogg}} '''Serious Patroller:''' Hello, Rover. This is our temporary storage site. Help yourself to anything you need.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_118_2.ogg}} '''Serious Patroller:''' People have generously donated a lot of supplies, and we must not disappoint them. Our mission is to defend this location at all costs.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_118_3.ogg}} '''Serious Patroller:''' If you have questions, talk to Director Taoqi at the nearby pass. She's in charge.
----
;(If player talks to Yhan before Taoqi)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_16_1.ogg}} '''Yhan:''' You still up for another fight or two?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_16_2.ogg}} '''Resilient Midnight Ranger:''' Don't underestimate us, sir! Absolutely!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_16_3.ogg}} '''High-spirited Midnight Ranger:''' We'll make sure those monsters leave defeated!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_16_4.ogg}} '''Yhan:''' Good. That's the spirt. Remember what I've taught you!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_7_16_5.ogg}} '''Yhan:''' Safety first, then take down as many of them as you can. Understood?
